title: 第一題：網路商城
question: 本月適逢88節，網路商城推出消費滿499免60元運費。請根據消費者的消費金額，計算總共需花費多少元（含運費）。

test_case.note: 總消費金額為120元，且未滿499元，需60元運費，共花費180元。
總消費金額為500元，因滿499元免運費，共花費500元。

en.title: Q1: Online Shop
en.question: Big sale this month! Shipping is $60. If you buy $499 or more, shipping is free. Input how much you buy. Output the total price (with shipping).

test_case.note: You buy $120. That is less than $499, so shipping is $60. Total: $180.
You buy $500. That is $499 or more, so shipping is free. Total: $500.
